title: Senior Media Buyer — Paid Search, Shopping, Display, Social & Retail Media
skills: Personally execute campaigns from planning and setup through daily optimization and reporting.
Develop campaign strategies and account structures tailored to each brand’s products, customers, and business goals.
Build and optimize Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns, along with Meta acquisition and retargeting campaigns.

Own budget allocation, pacing, bidding, keyword research, audience development, and ad copy testing.

description:
About the job

Type: Full-Time 

Compensation: $40-45K USD




Please submit your resume in English.




About Us

We are a multi-brand pet products company serving customers through subscription and single-purchase ecommerce businesses. We are looking for an experienced Senior Media Buyer to own daily paid media execution and help grow our brands.




About the Role

You will personally build, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok, and Pinterest, with strong expertise in Google and Meta.




This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently audit accounts, diagnose performance issues, manage budgets, and translate business objectives into effective campaigns. You will make daily decisions inside the ad accounts and provide clear recommendations to leadership.




Candidates with agency or leadership backgrounds are welcome, provided they have recent execution experience and want to remain directly involved in campaign management.




What You’ll Do

Personally execute campaigns from planning and setup through daily optimization and reporting.
Develop campaign strategies and account structures tailored to each brand’s products, customers, and business goals.
Build and optimize Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns, along with Meta acquisition and retargeting campaigns.
Manage advertising across Microsoft, TikTok, and Pinterest.
Own budget allocation, pacing, bidding, keyword research, audience development, and ad copy testing.
Conduct account audits to identify wasted spend, performance issues, and opportunities to scale.
Investigate changes in ROAS, acquisition costs, and conversion rates using campaign, creative, tracking, and website data.
Run structured creative and audience tests, working with the creative team on briefs and performance feedback.
Monitor reporting accuracy and identify conversion tracking or attribution discrepancies.
Present concise performance updates and actionable recommendations, including quarterly and year-end reviews.




Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, including recent responsibility for personally building and optimizing campaigns.
Ecommerce experience is mandatory, with direct responsibility for campaigns driving online purchases.
Strong Google Ads and Meta Ads expertise, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta sales campaigns.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, and Pinterest Ads.
Experience personally managing at least $30,000 USD in monthly advertising spend. Please distinguish your budget ownership from total agency or team spend.
Proven campaign results, supported by examples explaining the starting metrics, actions you took, and outcomes.
Working knowledge of GA4, conversion tracking, product feeds, and ecommerce reporting.
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to diagnose underperformance and prioritize corrective actions.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience preparing leadership reports and presentations.
Clear English communication and the ability to work independently across multiple brands.
Proactive, organized, collaborative, and receptive to feedback, with consistent follow-through.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience with DTC subscription and repeat-purchase brands.
Experience managing multiple ecommerce accounts simultaneously.
Experience developing creative testing strategies.
Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certification

description:
About the job

Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?

At  Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Ready to accelerate your career in Gaming? Want to shape the future of advertising on Roblox?

We are looking for a high-energy, AI-native Client Partner to join our team at Aleph, focusing specifically on Roblox in Mexico.

If you live and breathe technology, love the gaming industry, and use AI tools to supercharge your daily life, this is the perfect place to build your future.

Who You Are

We are looking for a dynamic professional who brings a fresh perspective, immense drive, and a passion for innovation.



Growth Mindset: You are eager to fast-track your professional journey, master new skills at lightning speed, and make a tangible impact from day one. 
"Full AI" Oriented: You don't just know what AI is, it’s woven into how you think and work. You actively use tools like Gemini, Claude, or automation to learn, create, and organize your workflow. You are always looking for ways to leverage AI to work smarter. 
Tech or Gaming Enthusiast: You have a deep, genuine passion for the gaming industry (if you understand or play Roblox, that's a massive plus!) and you naturally gravitate toward the latest tech trends. 
High Energy & Hyper-Adaptable: The digital ad world moves fast, and Aleph moves faster. You thrive in environments of constant change, pivot smoothly when priorities shift, and bring infectious positive energy to the team. 



What You’ll Do

As a Client Partner for Roblox, you will be at the intersection of brands, gaming, and cutting-edge ad tech:



Help brands and agencies understand the power of Roblox and how to build successful campaigns. 
Use AI tools to optimize your workflow, build pitches, analyze data, and stay ahead of the curve. 
Manage client relationships with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. 
Collaborate with a global, fast-paced team where innovation is celebrated. 



Why Join Us?



The Brand: Represent Roblox, one of the most exciting and dynamic platforms in the world. 
The Culture: At Aleph, change is our constant. You will be surrounded by brilliant minds in a flexible, high-growth environment. 
The Future: We don't just tolerate AI; we expect you to push the boundaries of how it's used to elevate your daily work. 



 Ready to jump in? If you are energetic, adaptable, and ready to kickstart your growth at the intersection of AI and Gaming, let’s talk!

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

#ALEPH

We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy or contact us at [email protected] .

description:
About the job

All candidates from LATAM countries are welcome to apply!!




About the Role

As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it.

Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.




Responsibilities

Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages.
Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar.
Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance.
Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy.
Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments.
Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.
Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test.
Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.




Requirements

Must-Have:

3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience.
Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting.
DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience.
Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work.
Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health.
Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns.
Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion.
Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows.




Nice to Have:

Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools.
Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.
Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate creative production, analysis, research, and troubleshooting.

title: User Growth Intern
description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a User Growth Intern you’ll be the go-to expert for data-driven decision-making, working directly with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across Latam to drive impactful initiatives and find operational efficiencies. You’ll leverage your expertise in SQL, Python, or R to uncover insights and shape strategy. This is your chance to be at the heart of decision-making, influence business growth, and collaborate with dynamic teams across a fast-paced, innovative organization.

In this role, you'll be...

Serving as the primary source of data-driven insights, providing actionable recommendations to the leadership team. Analyzing complex datasets using SQL, Python, or R to identify trends, opportunities, and efficiencies across Didi Food. Monitoring and reporting on key performance metrics, ensuring the business stays on track to meet its goals. Leading strategic projects, from ideation to execution, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable impact. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive initiatives and optimize processes. Developing and delivering compelling presentations to stakeholders, translating data into clear, actionable insights.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Advanced proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python or R) for data analysis and visualization. Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and advanced Excel skills. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for improvement. Fluent in English and Spanish.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Formarás parte de un equipo multifuncional en el que podrás desarrollar habilidades de liderazgo, planeación y trabajo en equipo.

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

About the job

PROPÓSITO DEL PUESTO


Desarrollar, implementar y optimizar iniciativas de marketing D2C que impulsen la demanda, el tráfico, las ventas y la rentabilidad de los canales LTH oficiales: Centros de Servicio LTH, Servicio a Domicilio, e-commerce, marketplaces y contact center. Responsable de administrar programas comerciales, promociones, marketing local, proveedores y proyectos de desarrollo del canal, aplicando creatividad práctica para transformar oportunidades en soluciones, promociones y experiencias diferenciadas. Apoya la toma de decisiones mediante análisis de negocio, casos de inversión y recomendaciones basadas en datos.


 RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES
 Crecimiento y desarrollo del canal D2C


Desarrollar y ejecutar iniciativas que incrementen el tráfico, las ventas y la rentabilidad de Centros de Servicio y Servicio a Domicilio. Identificar oportunidades, alianzas, convenios y mejores prácticas, y proponer soluciones creativas y viables que fortalezcan el desempeño, la diferenciación y la madurez del punto de venta.


 Promociones y activación de demanda


Administrar y ejecutar promociones, campañas estacionales y programas comerciales. Diseñar mecánicas y activaciones creativas, prácticas y ejecutables que generen demanda y valor para el cliente. Evaluar resultados y recomendar mejoras para maximizar el impacto y el retorno de inversión.


 Capacidades D2C y excelencia operativa


Desarrollar, documentar y desplegar procesos, playbooks, herramientas y mejores prácticas que mejoren la consistencia de ejecución y permitan escalar el modelo D2C a través de la red.


 Marketing local y generación de tráfico


Administrar la estrategia de Google Business Profile y las iniciativas digitales orientadas a incrementar visibilidad y visitas a los Centros de Servicio. Medir el desempeño por ubicación y proponer acciones de optimización.


 Análisis de negocio y gestión del desempeño


Analizar ventas, mezcla, rentabilidad, promociones y KPIs del canal. Desarrollar casos de negocio y recomendaciones que apoyen la planeación, la toma de decisiones y la mejora continua.


 Gestión de presupuesto, agencias y proveedores


Administrar las iniciativas asignadas dentro del presupuesto D2C y coordinar agencias, proveedores, órdenes de compra y entregables. Negociar condiciones, asegurar calidad, controlar costes y reportar avances al Gerente de Mercadotecnia D2C.


 Colaboración transversal y propuesta de valor


Coordinar la implementación con las áreas internas y distribuidores. Participar en la evolución de la propuesta de valor aportando la perspectiva de marketing D2C y propuestas creativas de experiencia y diferenciación, y coordinando las acciones aprobadas, sin ser responsable de la estrategia de marca, el diseño arquitectónico o nuevos modelos de negocio.


 PERFIL DEL CANDIDATO


Formación

Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín. Especialización en Marketing Digital, Analítica o Desarrollo Comercial es deseable.

Experiencia

5 años o más en Marketing, Trade Marketing, Retail Marketing, Desarrollo Comercial, canales de distribución o negocios D2C. Experiencia en gestión de proyectos, agencias, proveedores y análisis comercial.

Habilidades técnicas

Marketing D2C, marketing digital, Google Business Profile, performance marketing, análisis financiero básico, gestión de proyectos, Excel avanzado, Power BI deseable y desarrollo de casos de negocio.

Habilidades conductuales

Orientación a resultados, pensamiento analítico y estratégico, organización, autonomía, negociación, colaboración, influencia sin autoridad formal y enfoque al cliente. Creatividad práctica para proponer soluciones, promociones y experiencias que generen demanda, diferenciación y valor para el cliente.


 KPIs DEL PUESTO
Crecimiento de ventas y tráfico en Centros de Servicio y Servicio a Domicilio.

About the job

All candidates from LATAM countries are welcome to apply!!




About the Role

As a CRO / Website Optimization Specialist, you will own a client's website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap from opportunity identification through execution and analysis. This is not a strategy-only position: you will formulate hypotheses, build and launch tests yourself, analyze performance, and determine what should happen next.

You'll have meaningful autonomy across Shopify, landing pages, quizzes, cart optimization, analytics, and experimentation tools. The right person combines strong CRO judgment with the technical confidence to make changes independently without relying on the client to finish or troubleshoot the execution.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.




Responsibilities

Own the website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on customer behavior, data, and potential conversion impact.
Turn conversion opportunities into clear hypotheses with defined success metrics and a rationale for why each test is worth running.
Personally build, QA, and launch A/B tests using Intelligems or comparable experimentation platforms.
Make Shopify front-end changes independently, including landing page updates, merchandising improvements, UX changes, and conversion-focused site enhancements.
Build and optimize landing pages rather than relying solely on designers or developers to execute your recommendations.
Improve quizzes and personalization funnels using Digioh or comparable tools to increase engagement and progression through the purchase journey.
Optimize cart and upsell experiences using Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify conversion tools.
Use GA4 and platform-level analytics to evaluate website behavior, conversion performance, event tracking, and experiment outcomes.
Translate experiment results into clear next steps, including follow-up tests, rollouts, iterations, or changes in roadmap priority.
Troubleshoot unfamiliar website and platform issues independently using documentation, support resources, AI tools, and structured problem-solving.




Requirements

Must-Have:

3-6+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, e-commerce website optimization, growth, or a closely related role, with flexibility for candidates whose experience demonstrates equivalent depth.
Strong practical knowledge of e-commerce conversion optimization, including funnels, customer journeys, merchandising, UX, and key conversion levers.
Hands-on Shopify front-end experience with the ability to make and troubleshoot website changes independently.
Proven ownership of A/B testing from opportunity identification and hypothesis creation through implementation, analysis, and next-step recommendations.
Hands-on experience with Intelligems or a comparable experimentation platform, plus working knowledge of GA4 and website conversion analytics.
Ability to personally build landing pages and conversion experiences rather than only producing briefs for designers or developers.
Strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to follow detailed written or video instructions carefully when working with sensitive website or company information.




Nice to Have:

Experience using Digioh for quizzes, funnels, personalization, or comparable conversion experiences.
Experience with Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify upsell and cart-optimization tools.
Direct experience working with DTC e-commerce brands.
Experience optimizing subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Previous experience in a role that combined strategic CRO ownership with substantial hands-on execution.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng

Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas

AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We work across web and mobile surfaces, partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, and use experimentation, observability, and user behaviour to guide what we build next.

The opportunity


Design, develop, and maintain high-quality consumer-facing features across web (React) and mobile (React Native), owning the full experience from concept to production monitoring.

Lead and collaborate on complex cross-platform initiatives, driving alignment across web and mobile surfaces.

Work AI-natively, we use AI tools across the full SDLC and expect engineers to have a structured, opinionated workflow, not just autocomplete.


What You Bring


6+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on consumer-facing web and/or mobile products.

Production experience with React Native and cross-platform mobile development, including App Store and Google Play release pipelines.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. title: Senior Software Engineer - Growth Team Lead
description:
About the job

About Trivelta

Trivelta is the worldʼs premier, modular iGaming platform complete with native and web apps, robust sportsbook and casino infrastructure, a comprehensive back office tool, and an encompassing suite of social features. We power an international suite of iGaming operations today and are rapidly expanding through the international market.

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own the design and delivery of systems within our propriety growth engine. Our growth engineer is responsible for platform-wide attribution and retention via dynamic bonusing, smart attribution, and a complete suite of affiliate tooling.

Senior is where scope stops being a single feature. You will be trusted with the projects where the right answer is genuinely unclear, and you will make the team around you better while you deliver them.

What you'll do

Own the design and delivery of systems within the Growth domain, from architecture through production operation.

Decompose large, ambiguous projects into workstreams the team can run in parallel — and find the genuinely hard part early rather than discovering it in month three.

Write design docs and architecture decision records that outlive the project and anticipate the next few years of change.

Set the bar for the codebase: refactor toward clarity as a habit, and introduce abstractions that others adopt because they help.

Design the testing strategy for your systems and improve CI reliability, so the team can ship confidently.

Lead incident investigation, and produce blameless postmortems whose action items measurably reduce recurrence.

Mentor engineers deliberately, and use code review as a coaching surface rather than only a defect filter.

Act as a genuine peer to Product and Design — propose cheaper solutions to the real user problem, and push back on scope with data.

Translate technical risk into business consequences for stakeholders, and deliver bad news early with options attached.

What we're looking for

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

You have owned a non-trivial system in production — designed it, shipped it, operated it, and lived with the consequences.

Strong design judgment: you can tell which abstractions earn their complexity and which are speculative.

Demonstrated mentorship. People you have worked with got better.

You can hold a technical position under pressure, and change it when the evidence changes.

Bonus points

Depth in ad-tech, player-journey-mapping, or an adjacent domain.

Experience with high volume system architectures.

Experience leading a migration or a deprecation that other people had to execute.

About the job

Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position 

The Regulatory Post Market Surveillance Specialist investigates customer complaints, makes an initial reporting decision, provides failure analysis letters, and ensures completeness and consistency of complaint and related documentation.

Essential Job Duties


Investigating complaints daily:
Perform the preliminary classification of complaints and escalate complaints that require additional review.
Perform Failure Analysis investigation review and escalate complaints that require additional review.
File Malfunction MDR Reports as identified
Escalate Adverse Event or Incident reports to Level IV Analysts as identified
Evaluate documentation for completeness and consistency and assign additional actions as necessary to close the complaint file.
Approve final complaint file for closure after all applicable actions are completed.
Manage complaint workload to required backlog goals.
Review and analyze lot documentation (DHRs) to determine if there are any anomalies that maybe related to reported product failures.
Escalate complaints to the Regulatory Post Market Surveillance Manager or Lead when new failure modes are encountered
Escalate complaints to the Post Market Investigation (PMI) group as required
Evaluate complaints for reporting requirements in accordance with company procedures and Regulatory requirements.
Interface with Customer Service and hospitals to gather additional information required for complaint investigation, including retrieval of RMA
Create customer response letters
Provide peer review and feedback of complaints and reports
Participate in new hire training and continuous Regulatory Compliance training as required
Participate in process improvement activities to continuously improve process effectiveness

Qualifications

Required Education and Training 

Education - degree in engineering, life science, or equivalent

English proficiency required: 85% (spoken and written).

Experience – 2+ years of experience in medical device field, with experience or exposure in the following areas:


Knowledge and understanding with Medical Device Complaint files and quality record documentation
Knowledge and understanding of Regulatory reporting requirements for Medical Devices (US FDA requirements, EU MDD requirements, etc.)
General technical and or clinical medical device knowledge

None

Additional Information

Intuitive es un empleador que brinda igualdad de oportunidades de empleo. Proporcionamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados cualificados, y prohibimos cualquier tipo de discriminación y acoso, independientemente de su raza, sexo, condición de embarazo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, color, edad, religión, condición de veterano protegido o de discapacidad, información genética o cualquier otra condición protegida por las leyes federales, estatales o locales aplicables.

Aviso sobre los Controles de Exportación de EE. UU.: De acuerdo con las Regulaciones de Administración de Exportaciones de EE. UU. (15 CFR


743.13(b)), algunos puestos en Intuitive Surgical pueden estar sujetos a controles de exportación de EE. UU. para candidatos que sean nacionales de países actualmente bajo embargo o sanciones.


Cierta información que usted proporcione como parte de la solicitud será utilizada para determinar si Intuitive Surgical necesitará (i) obtener una licencia de exportación del gobierno de EE. UU. en su nombre (nota: el proceso de obtención de la licencia puede tardar entre 3 y más de 6 meses) o (ii) implementar un Plan de Control de Tecnología (“TCP”, por sus siglas en inglés) (nota: normalmente este paso agrega 2 semanas al proceso de contratación).

Para cualquier puesto en Intuitive sujeto a controles de exportación, las ofertas finales están condicionadas a la obtención de una licencia de exportación aprobada y/o a la ejecución de un TCP antes de la fecha de inicio del empleado potencial, la cual puede o no ser flexible, y dentro de un plazo que no obstaculice de manera irrazonable la necesidad de contratación. Si aplica, los candidatos serán notificados e instruidos sobre cualquier requisito relacionado con estos fines.

About the job

Join a team that puts people at the center of everything.




At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it’s about connecting humans with humans. We’re a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




You’ll join a 100-year-old American manufacturer of premium kitchen appliances — family-owned for four generations, still manufacturing in-house in Ohio, and selling in 130 countries. These are products built to survive a decade of daily use — so change control here isn’t paperwork. A wrong revision or a missing approval shows up on a production line, and eventually in someone’s kitchen.




As a Change Control Specialist, you coordinate and administer engineering change control and product data management across the product lifecycle — keeping product structures, engineering documentation, Bills of Material and change records accurate and released on time inside the PLM and ERP systems.




Working with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Project teams, you coordinate the review, approval and release of engineering changes. This is a hybrid role based in Monterrey.




You don’t need an engineering degree for this role. What matters is practical experience inside an engineering or manufacturing environment, supporting or administering change-control processes.




What You'll Do

Administer Change Requests (CRs) and Change Notices (CNs) from initiation through release.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to gather the information, approvals and documentation each change requires.
Maintain product information in the PLM system: BOMs, part attributes, revisions and effectivity dates.

Communicate change status and follow up with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain.
Identify data inconsistencies, incomplete documentation or missing approvals, and escalate or resolve them.
Support continuous improvement of change and product data processes.




What You Bring

Around 5 years in engineering change control, product data or configuration management, document control, BOM management or manufacturing engineering support.
Direct experience administering or supporting formal engineering changes: ECOs, ECNs, ECRs, Change Requests or Change Notices. This one is required.
Experience creating, updating, maintaining or validating Bills of Material (BOMs). Also required.
Confidence with part numbers, revisions, product structures and change records.
Experience with an ERP system such as Oracle, SAP or equivalent.
Experience coordinating approvals across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain and Purchasing.
Strong Excel and MS Office skills, and the ability to work independently within established processes.

description:
About the job

Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Customer Success Associate to join our Mexico team and help build lasting partnerships with Clara's clients. You'll manage a portfolio of accounts, ensuring they get the most value from our platform while acting as their trusted advisor. This is a cross-functional role that requires a mix of relationship management, commercial drive, and product insight.

Your mission will be to drive customer retention, identify growth opportunities, and deliver a seamless experience from onboarding through renewal. You'll collaborate with Sales, Product, and Marketing to advocate for customer needs and contribute to Clara's long-term success. At Clara, we value owners who take pride in the success of their customers and aren't afraid to dive deep into the data to solve complex problems.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves


2–3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales. 
Background in fintech, banking, SaaS, or financial services. 
Proficiency with CRM tools, specifically Hubspot. 
Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows and improve response times. 
Working proficiency in English and Spanish. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
Adaptability to fast-changing environments and a proven track record of execution. 
Experience identifying upsell or cross-sell opportunities to drive account expansion. 


Nice to haves


Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets or Metabase. 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams. 
Familiarity with product usage monitoring or customer health scoring. 
Strategic thinking and an eye for process improvements. 
A good sense of humor. 


Why join Clara

At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are


We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. 
Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. 
Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. 
Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. 
Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. 
Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. 


What we believe in


#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. 
#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. 
#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. 
#Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. 
#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. 
#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. 


What we offer


Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one 
Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) 
Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths 
High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together 
Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact 
Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results 


If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

description:
About the job

Team: Human Data

 Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

As a Senior Human Data Operations Partner, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth execution of end-to-end operational processes that power Prolific's specialised participant pools. You’ll act as a key enabler for client-specific projects, working closely with delivery teams to align participant-related processes with strategic AI customer needs. You’ll also work to transform these processes and workflows into scalable solutions, partnering closely with our product and tech teams to do this. This role demands a hands-on approach to participant onboarding, verification, and quality management, as well as cross-functional collaboration to meet the demands of both internal stakeholders and external clients

What you’ll be doing in the role 


Develop detailed project plans, workflows, and enablement materials to support efficient delivery.
Maintain Prolific’s participant pools as high-quality, diverse, and optimised to meet customer demands.
Implement and manage verification processes for domain experts and AI taskers, ensuring their skills and qualifications meet client-specific requirements.
Continuously optimise participant onboarding and activation funnels to enhance retention and task performance.
Monitor participant engagement and quality metrics, using insights to drive improvements.
Contribute to upskilling programmes and certification processes for participants involved in complex AI tasks
Work closely with product, data, science, and customer success teams to align operational priorities with strategic objectives.
Collaborate with product managers to transform manual processes into scalable, technology-driven solutions.
Act as a conduit between delivery teams and operational functions to ensure seamless project execution.
Document and communicate operational changes to stakeholders across the business, ensuring smooth adoption.


What you’ll bring to the role


Proven experience in human data operations, ideally in marketplace or platform environments.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong project management skills, with attention to detail and operational execution.
Experience in implementing and optimising processes to improve efficiency and scalability.
Proficiency in operational tools and systems such as, Zapier,, and HubSpot.
Exceptional communication and documentation skills, with a track record of stakeholder enablement.
Confidence with data analysis and operational metrics to support decision-making and continuous improvement
Familiarity with human data operations, product or data operations, participant recruitment, or managing global crowdsourcing/gig-economy platforms.
Experience supporting AI/ML lifecycle projects, such as data labelling, annotation, or domain-specific task curation.
Understanding of Prolific’s platform and its role in delivering high-quality human data for AI research.


Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.

description:
About the job

About Netafim:

At Netafim, we work side by side with millions of farmers and communities around the world to address one of agriculture’s most pressing challenges: how to produce more food with fewer resources in an increasingly unpredictable environment. For more than 60 years, Netafim has been a global leader in precision irrigation, powered by people working across teams and geographies to bring together agronomy, engineering, data, and innovation.

Together, we help improve decision-making in the field and drive better outcomes across crops and climates — turning complexity into clarity and making agriculture more precise, efficient, and sustainable to enable farmers to grow more with less.

Position Overview

We are looking for a dedicated, energetic, and technically curious Customer Success Representative to support our Digital Farming (GrowSphere) customers. This role is focused on proactive customer engagement, onboarding, education, and ongoing support to help growers get the most value from their automation and digital farming tools.

This position serves as a primary point of contact for new and existing customers. Primarily through scheduled phone and virtual meetings, ensuring they understand how to use the GrowSphere platform and feel confident incorporating it into their daily operations. The ideal candidate enjoys teaching, problem‑solving, and working with innovative agricultural technology while building strong, professional relationships with growers.

The majority of time will be spent at a desk managing customer calls and follow‑ups, with opportunities to participate in field visits, troubleshooting, equipment testing, and sales or support meetings when call volume allows.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Success


Proactively schedule and conduct onboarding sessions for new Digital Farming customers.
Maintain regular follow‑ups with existing customers to review system usage, adoption, and overall success.
Serve as a trusted resource to help growers understand and effectively utilize the GrowSphere platform.
Communicate clearly and professionally with growers of varying technical comfort levels, adapting your approach to each operation.
Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes through better system usage, education, or configuration.


Technical Support & Escalation


Provide basic troubleshooting and guidance for the GrowSphere operating system and connected equipment.
Identify customers who require additional technical or in‑field support and escalate appropriately to internal teams.
Recognize when on‑farm visits or advanced support are needed and coordinate handoff to the correct resource.
Participate in field visits, testing, and troubleshooting activities when appropriate.


Growth Identification & Internal Collaboration


Identify customers who may benefit from expanding or optimizing their Digital Farming systems.
Clearly document and pass qualified expansion opportunities to the appropriate Key Account Manager.
Work closely with sales, technical, and field teams to ensure a smooth customer experience and clear internal communication.


CRM & Process Management


Accurately document all customer interactions, notes, action items, and follow‑ups in the CRM system.
Manage a pipeline of scheduled calls, follow‑ups, and inbound customer inquiries.
Track customer engagement and recurring themes to support continuous improvement efforts.


Minimum Qualifications


Ability to read, write, and speak English clearly and professionally.
Spanish language skills are a strong plus.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Comfortable spending a majority of the workday on phone calls and virtual meetings.
Proficient with, or willing to learn, CRM systems.
Proficient with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and stay organized.
Able to work indoors and outdoors as needed and follow safety and operational guidelines.


Preferred Education & Experience


High School Diploma or equivalent required.
Agricultural degree or coursework preferred.
Experience in agriculture, irrigation, ag technology, or related fields strongly preferred.
Previous experience in customer success, customer support, technical support, or account coordination is a plus.


Skills & Competencies


Technically savvy with an interest in agricultural technology and automation.
Strong problem‑solving and prioritization skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear, practical, and grower‑friendly way.
Detail‑oriented with strong documentation habits.
Comfortable working across teams and escalating issues when appropriate.


Desired Traits


Self‑motivated, dependable, and team‑oriented.
Positive attitude with a genuine desire to help customers succeed.
Enjoys teaching, learning, and continuous improvement.
Curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic ag environment.


About Orbia:

Orbia Advance Corporation is a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in the Polymer Solutions, Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor & Energy Materials sectors. The five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on ensuring food and water security, expanding information access and connectivity, and advancing decarbonization and the energy transition with basic and advanced materials, specialty products, and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 22,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with a strong U.S. manufacturing presence and headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam, and Tel Aviv. The company generated $7.6 billion in revenue in 2025. To learn more, visit: orbia.com

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.

About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

We are looking for a Senior Associate, Data Strategy to help turn audience data into actionable marketing strategies. Working alongside Planning, Activation, and Analytics teams, you will identify growth opportunities, develop audience insights, and connect data and technology to support precision marketing across paid, owned, and earned media.

You will collaborate closely with agency teams, client stakeholders, and data partners to execute audience strategies—from analysis and audience architecture through activation and validation. This role combines analytical thinking, technical knowledge, and confident client-facing communication to translate audience insights into clear recommendations.

In this role, you will:


Generate, manage, and quality-check audience metadata, ensuring the audience library remains accurate and continuously updated.

Monitor media data and audience syndication, reporting on audience sizing, delivery, and performance.
Manage day-to-day project delivery, coordinating with agency teams to keep work organized, communicate updates, and meet deadlines.
Help develop PowerPoint presentations and compelling storylines for client, internal, and new business projects, building understanding of consumers, culture, and brands.
Collaborate with communications planning and media planning stakeholders to translate insights into recommendations that address strategic business questions.
Actively contribute to team meetings, working sessions, client discussions, and brainstorms, helping move decisions and next steps forward.


Skills And Experience

Experience in media or digital strategy, with knowledge of AdTech, MarTech, and programmatic advertising.
An analytical mindset and an understanding of online and offline media ecosystems and how data informs marketing decisions.
Strong quantitative skills, including experience with data entry and basic data analysis.
Familiarity with syndicated audience and measurement tools, such as comScore, Nielsen, and MRI.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
The ability to translate audience data, analytical approaches, and findings into clear insights and strategic implications.
Confident client-facing communication and the ability to collaborate closely with agency partners, client stakeholders, and data partners.
Strong attention to detail, while maintaining a clear understanding of the broader business objective.
The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Intellectual curiosity, a willingness to learn emerging technologies, and a proactive approach to exploring what data means for a client’s business.

description:
About the job

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing US-Based pet brand selling innovative tools that have quickly become essentials in millions of homes.

Their products reach customers through their direct-to-consumer store and major retailers. Creator-led commerce—especially on TikTok Shop—is one of their fastest-growing acquisition channels.




Position Summary

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and creator-obsessed TikTok Shop Affiliate Specialist to support the daily operations and scaling of our creator program.

In this hands-on role, your primary mission is to ensure our affiliate pipeline never stalls. You will drive daily outreach, manage creator sample fulfillment, coordinate automated communications, moderate our creator community, and analyze short-form content patterns that generate revenue. Working directly with our Director of Content and Community, you will turn high-level campaign plans into consistent operational action that directly impacts month-over-month affiliate GMV.




Key Responsibilities

1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Operations

Support the day-to-day execution and operational health of the client's TikTok Shop affiliate program.
Build, launch, and optimize creator outreach campaigns and automated follow-up sequences using Cruva.
Review incoming sample requests, evaluating creators based on audience fit, content quality, and sales potential.
Coordinate time-sensitive sample fulfillment workflows directly with our warehouse logistics team.
Monitor TikTok Shop account health, handle documentation, manage support tickets, and resolve operational roadblocks quickly.
Track program risks, performance gaps, and activation metrics, reporting insights directly to the Affiliate Marketing Manager.

2. Campaign Execution & Content Analysis

Help execute affiliate campaigns, creator contests, seasonal challenges, and performance incentives.
Clear campaign details, deadlines, and deliverables to creators; track participation and follow up to drive posting volume.
Analyze creator content to identify why specific videos win or underperform (evaluating hooks, lighting, product demonstrations, pacing, and calls-to-action).
Translate winning content patterns into actionable creator briefs and share performance insights with internal teams.
Develop and test new campaign angles to reactivate dormant creators and underutilized communication channels.

3. Community Management & Engagement

Act as the frontline voice for the brand across TikTok Shop Affiliate Center Messages and our Creator Discord.
Foster an active, supportive creator community by posting announcements, content inspiration, challenge updates, and actionable tips.
Answer creator inquiries promptly, ensuring affiliates feel supported rather than treated as transactional partners.
Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline recurring reminders, updates, and creator follow-ups.

4. Ambassador, UGC & Social Strategy Support

Support the reactivation and ongoing management of our ambassador program via Upfluence.
Source UGC creators for scripted ad content, retail push campaigns, and new product launch initiatives.
Support the broader organic social strategy by scheduling approved short-form content in Later.
Edit raw UGC clips into platform-native, high-converting social posts across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing or supporting a TikTok Shop affiliate program for a CPG/consumer brand (outside of the fashion category).
Platform Knowledge: Proficiency with TikTok Shop Affiliate Center, short-form social platforms, and creator management software. Direct experience with Cruva, Upfluence, Discord, and Later is strongly preferred.
Content Literacy: Strong instincts for short-form video mechanics—you know what makes a compelling hook, a smooth product demo, and a converting call-to-action.
Technical Skills: Experience utilizing AI tools and workflows to automate repetitive creator communication and task management. Basic short-form video editing skills.
Soft Skills: Exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and strong written communication skills tailored for creator relationships.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Outreach & Activation: Consistency of creator outreach and speed of sample request processing.
Creator Participation: Increase in creator posting volume and participation rate in active campaigns.
Community Engagement: Response time and engagement levels within Discord and Affiliate Center messages.
Revenue Impact: Measurable contribution to overall month-over-month TikTok Shop affiliate GMV growth.

What We Offer

Work Environment: 100% Fully Remote work structure (US-based).
Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO) package plus quarterly flex days to recharge.
Career Growth: Professional development support and opportunities to grow within a high-growth e-commerce brand.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
About the job

Key Account Manager (KAM)

UBICACIÓN: PUERTO VALLARTA, JALISCO




ÁREA: COMERCIAL Y DESARROLLO DE NEGOCIOS DE MADERA, GLULAM Y CARPINTERÍA




OBJETIVO DE LA POSICIÓN:

Perfil técnico-comercial de alto nivel encargado de desarrollar y gestionar relaciones estratégicas con oficinas de arquitectura, diseñadores, desarrolladores y constructores. El candidato ideal fusiona habilidades de negociación ejecutiva con el entendimiento técnico de proyectos estructurales y de carpintería fina, acompañando los proyectos desde la concepción hasta la entrega final en obra.




PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

• Desarrollo de Negocios: Identificar, prospectar y cerrar oportunidades comerciales con cuentas clave (despachos, constructoras y desarrolladores) en Puerto Vallarta y la región de Costa Alegre.

• Gestión de Proyectos Integral (End-to-End): Coordinar y dar seguimiento al ciclo completo del proyecto: diseño, ingeniería, cotización, suministro, logística, colocación y entrega final.

• Consultoría Técnica: Interpretar requerimientos arquitectónicos, planos y especificaciones para resolver necesidades complejas de suministro e instalación de estructuras de madera y carpinterías.

• Enlace Estratégico: Actuar como el punto de contacto principal entre la dirección o gerencia del cliente y los equipos internos de ingeniería, producción y ejecución en obra.

• Control de Entregables: Asegurar el cumplimiento riguroso de los tiempos, alcances, presupuestos y estándares de calidad acordados con el cliente.




PERFIL REQUERIDO Y COMPETENCIAS

• Educación: Licenciatura concluida en Arquitectura, Ingeniería Civil, Diseño Industrial o carreras afines.

• Experiencia: Más de 8 años de trayectoria comprobable en gestión de proyectos de construcción, estructuras de madera, carpintería arquitectónica o comercialización de materiales especializados.

• Relacionamiento Comercial: Experiencia sólida interactuando con oficinas de diseño, constructoras y desarrolladores de proyectos residenciales y hoteleros de alta gama.

• Capacidad Técnica: Habilidad avanzada para comprender planos constructivos, coordinar logística y resolver contingencias técnicas directamente en el sitio de obra.

• Habilidades Blandas: Alta capacidad de negociación, comunicación ejecutiva, liderazgo, orientación al servicio y un estricto sentido de responsabilidad en el seguimiento.




PROPUESTA ECONÓMICA Y BENEFICIOS

• Compensación: Sueldo competitivo superior al promedio del sector, determinado según la experiencia y el perfil técnico-comercial evaluado.

• Apoyo de Relocalización: Paquete de asistencia de vivienda en Puerto Vallarta.

• Desarrollo Profesional: Incorporación a una empresa líder en expansión con oportunidades de crecimiento a mediano plazo y participación directa en proyectos de arquitectura Premium de alto impacto.

About the job

Role Description This is a full-time hybric role for a Sales Executive at Rex Technology by Netjer. The Sales Executive will identify and qualify new business opportunities, manage a pipeline of prospects, and conduct discovery calls to understand client needs in e-commerce revenue scaling and venue monetization. The role includes preparing and delivering presentations and proposals, collaborating with internal teams to tailor solutions, and negotiating contracts to close deals. The Sales Executive will maintain relationships with existing clients, track performance against sales targets, and provide feedback on market trends and customer requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities also involve using CRM tools to manage accounts, documenting activities, and participating in virtual meetings and sales strategy sessions.




Qualifications

Strong skills in consultative selling, prospecting, and pipeline management for B2B technology or data-driven solutions.
Experience with solution-based sales in areas such as digital marketing, data analytics, or marketing funnels.
Proficiency using CRM platforms, sales productivity tools, and virtual communication tools (e.g., video conferencing, collaboration software).
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in clear business terms.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, prioritize tasks, and meet or exceed sales quotas.
Familiarity with e-commerce, consumer brands, or venue-based businesses is highly beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer, Telecom or IT career, or equivalent professional experience.
Prior experience in a Sales Executive, Account Executive, or Business Development role within technology or services is preferred.

About the job

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique


At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 

 Together we're on a mission to power every property in the world, and to do that, we need to find the best talent in the world. That's why we're on the search for a superstar 
Website Designer Specialist.


We’re looking for a Website Designer to join our Professional Services Team, who want to disrupt the travel industry and love to travel as much as we do. As a

Remote

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.
